title: HitBorder
description: HitBorder is a where the WorldBorder grows whenever players take damage. Includes admin commands, spawn protection, hardcore mode, sounds, and configurable settings — perfect for survival challenges and events.
body:
🌍 HitBorder – Every Hit Changes the World

HitBorder adds a completely new survival dynamic to your Minecraft server.

Whenever a player takes damage, the WorldBorder automatically grows. Every mistake expands the world — changing the pace and strategy of the game.

Perfect for:

🔥 Hardcore challenges

🎥 YouTube & streaming events

🏹 PvP survival servers

🧩 Community game modes

⚙️ Core Features

✅ Border grows on damage events
Supports configurable damage types.

✅ Fully customizable

Starting size

Growth per hit

Maximum size

Cooldown

✅ Hardcore Mode
Reaching the maximum border size can result in player death.

✅ Spawn Protection
Prevents block breaking/placing in the defined spawn area.

✅ Admin Commands

/hitborder setborder

/hitborder set

/hitborder grow

/hitborder hardcore

/hitborder setspawn

/hitborder reload

/hitborder toggle

/hitborder status

/hitborder version

✅ Optional Features

Join message showing current border size

Growth notification sound

Optional LuckPerms integration (soft depend)

Optional bStats metrics
